Archive a Work Entry Type

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to archive a work entry type that is no longer used, so it disappears from the lists but its history is kept.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Work Entry Types

Click Work Entry Types.

4. Find the work entry type

Type the name of the work entry type and press Enter.

5. Select it

Tick the box in front of the work entry type.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

7. Archive

Click Archive.

8. Confirm

Click Archive in the window to confirm.
